description: Auto-approve ONLY the status-board plugin's read-only scripts so viewing the board and running /status-board:start or /status-board:finish isn't interrupted by prompts for commands that change nothing. The `if` filters (Bash(python*) and Bash(STATUS_BOARD_*), for the watchdog-timer prefix) only spare unrelated commands the script; they approve nothing. Delegates to approve_read_only.py, which approves exactly one plain invocation, by bare unquoted python3 or python (optionally prefixed by unquoted STATUS_BOARD_WARN_SECS=<n> / STATUS_BOARD_KILL_SECS=<n>, the watchdog's timers), of THIS plugin install's own copy (an absolute script path that must resolve, symlinks followed, to the file shipped next to this hook) of: status_board.py (renders the board; any args) and plan_flow.py check ... (reads only — no fetch, no network, no write — and prints the facts and the steps to run). Never approved, so they still prompt: plan_flow.py with no subcommand or any subcommand other than check; plan_flow.py check with --root (another directory's git config could run commands under git status); every git command, push and README edit the check prints for Claude to carry out; a same-named script anywhere else or a relative script path; an interpreter given by path or in quotes; any other or quoted environment assignment; any command containing a character outside letters, digits, space and _ . / \ : = " ' - (so no chaining, redirection, $ expansion, braces, globs, ~ or substitution). Consent is granted at plugin install/trust time; delete this file to opt out (the skills still work, you'll just approve each script call).
